title: Chalk tallies in the Fold
notes: Bible 7.5: chalk tallies in the Fold, Horn counting the sleepers. Six strokes then a seventh in a smaller hand. The player's rescues are added later by the Fold work (mw-e39 follow-up), not here.

pages.text:
(On the stone by the door, in chalk: five strokes and a sixth, counted over and over until the chalk has gone through the stone. Beneath, in a smaller, steadier hand:)

One more tonight.
